information_order.stage_1: Read all repetition-1 interactions, choose one diagnostic interaction, fit the source basis, and freeze every model choice.
information_order.stage_2: Read only the chosen repetition-2 diagnostic interaction and seal predictions for the other two repetition-2 interactions.
information_order.stage_3: Verify the prediction seal before reading the eight held-action repetition-2 trajectories and score once.
information_order.rep3_rule: No repetition-3 numeric trajectory may be parsed by this study.

retrospective_status.reason: Repetition 2 has been available to earlier project analyses; this protocol supplies a newly frozen trajectory-geometry analysis but is not an independently blind confirmation.

claim_boundary: This is a retrospective source-frozen cross-action trajectory-geometry gate on separate Tracking Cloth recordings. It tests whether one observed interaction can index a repetition-1 response library well enough to predict two other repetition-2 interaction queries, with exact material-association, wrong-action, and diagnostic-copy controls. It is not a same-episode online probe-reset-act experiment, does not establish natural material causation, does not validate unrestricted nonlinear closure, does not provide an independently blind confirmation, and does not authorize numeric access to repetition 3.
